description: Scout: ETF news for one day from ETFIQ's ETF News, read from SEC filings: launches (funds that began trading), closures and closing notices, funds filed and not yet trading, name or ticker changes, fee changes and splits. Defaults to the latest day published (is_latest and lag_days say how old that is); pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for an earlier trading day, kind to see one kind, ticker for one fund. Each event is one dated sentence with its SEC form, filing date and link. Closures and launches come first. limit 1 to 100, default 25; matching is the whole count.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest published day.

kind.description: Optional: only this kind of event.

limit.description: Most events to return, 1 to 100. Default 25.

ticker.description: Optional: only events for this fund ticker.

name: etf_news_today

as_of.description: Date of the newest number in the answer.

citation.description: A ready citation string with the as-of date and the page address.

data.description: The answer, or null when ETFIQ refuses (then error and reason say why).

disclaimer_required.description: True when the answer carries numbers that need the not-advice line.

error.description: Present only on a refusal: what ETFIQ does not publish.

provenance.description: Where each number came from: field, source, as_of, source_uri.

reason.description: Present only on a refusal: why, and what to change.

tried.description: Present only on a refusal: what was looked up.

warnings.description: Caveats to show with the answer.
